We are introducing a new and improved content moderation tool. The Moderation endpoint improves upon our previous content filter, and is available for free today to OpenAI API developers.

### Official Announcement
Read the full update directly from the official source at [OpenAI News](https://openai.com/index/new-and-improved-content-moderation-tooling).

Stay tuned to [Modelverse](https://www.themodelverse.in) for real-time model analysis and benchmark coverage.
